exposure: combination of Foley catheter and oxytocin
outcome: newborn outcomes (Apgar scores at 5 minutes, NICU admission rates)
cohort: Two hundred pregnant women admitted to Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH) who were undergoing labor induction.
finding: Combination methods (Foley + Oxytocin) and PGE2 induction resulted in the shortest induction-to-delivery intervals and favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to oxytocin alone or Foley catheter alone.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were highest in the combination method (Foley + Oxytocin) group (84%) and PGE2 group (76%) compared to oxytocin alone (64%) or Foley alone (60%).
